style: ソムと店主の容姿、年齢感、服装は人物画のための選択。品物と修理代の状態は物語に従う。

files.prompt_en: Full-body game character sprite of Som, a locksmith at his first legitimate repair job, for a hand-painted low-fantasy RPG. A lean adult man with short uneven dark hair, a thoughtful narrow face and alert eyes; muted storm-blue work shirt with rolled cuffs, brown narrow leather work apron, simple belt, charcoal trousers and practical boots. He faces slightly to the viewer's right, both empty hands in a small, open explanatory gesture. Natural adult proportions, subtle brush textures, clear silhouette, softly directional warm light. A single figure centered on a 1024 by 1536 vertical transparent canvas, all hair, fingers and both boots fully in frame. Comfortable transparent margin around the whole figure. The only opaque pixels belong to the character.

files.prompt_en: Full-body game character sprite of a shopkeeper witnessing a locksmith repair, for a hand-painted low-fantasy RPG. A sturdy middle-aged woman with warm brown skin, dark hair braided in a low bun, a broad attentive face and a quietly resolute expression. Deep russet long-sleeved bodice over an oatmeal linen blouse, dark olive ankle-length skirt, neatly tied cloth sash and stout leather shoes. She stands in a calm three-quarter pose turned slightly to the viewer's left; one empty hand rests lightly against her opposite forearm. Natural adult proportions, subtle painterly texture, a clear silhouette, softly directional warm light. One centered figure on a 1024 by 1536 vertical transparent canvas. Show all hair, fingers, garment hem and shoes with comfortable clear margins around the entire figure. The only opaque pixels belong to the character.
